    Frequently asked questions

    Why is income tax lower when I choose 2027?

    From pay received in 2027, the National Tax Agency's new withholding tables apply. The basic deduction was raised in the 2026 tax reform, so for the same pay the monthly tax is the same or a little lower.

    My company takes much more income tax than this calculator shows. Why?

    Check whether you gave your company the 扶養控除等申告書 (declaration for dependants) form. Without it, tax is taken from the 乙 column, which is much higher. For example, in the 2027 table, pay of about 200,000 yen after insurance has 4,170 yen tax in the 甲 column (no dependants) but 19,200 yen in the 乙 column.

    Why does the pension amount stop rising at high pay?

    Employees' Pension uses standard monthly pay from 88,000 to 650,000 yen. Above 650,000 yen it stays at the top grade, so your share stays at 59,475 yen a month (9.15% of 650,000). Health insurance has more grades and keeps rising up to 1,390,000 yen.

    Why doesn't the calculator work out resident tax?

    Resident tax is decided by your city from the previous year's income, for people who had an address in Japan on January 1. It depends on your city and last year's deductions, so please type in the amount from your pay slip or the city's notice. In your first year in Japan it is usually 0.
